title: Black Friday Ad Creatives for Small Shops | Aidreamcapes
description: Get Black Friday ad creatives ready weeks ahead: bold product videos and banners with space for your deal. Add prices later and go live when your sale starts.
h1: Black Friday Ad Creatives You Can Prepare Weeks Ahead
lead: Make the clips and banners now, add the deal in your editor later, and head into the big sale weekend with every size ready.
secondary_keywords: Black Friday sale ads for ecommerce
intro: During Black Friday, feeds fill up with deals from every store at once. Shoppers scroll fast and compare a lot, so your ad needs a product they recognize instantly and an offer that's easy to read. Visuals rushed together the night before rarely manage both.

Aidreamcapes lets you make the visual side well ahead of time: vertical and square product clips (6, 10 or 15 seconds long) and square banners with bold backgrounds and space for your deal. Prices, countdowns and "doorbuster" labels go on later in CapCut or Ads Manager, so you can lock in the visuals before your discounts are final.

ideas.d: Your product lit against a black or deep-colored background, with open space for the deal.

ideas.t: Clip with room for a countdown
ideas.d: A vertical clip that leaves the top of the frame clear, so you can add a timer in your editor.
Several of your products arranged as a set for a holiday bundle deal.
A second visual in a different color and setting, so Monday's ads don't look like a rerun of Friday's.

plan.d: Choose the products you'll feature, clean up their photos, and try early versions in your regular ads to see which visuals people stop for.
Make the final clips and banners in every size, add the offer text, and submit ads early enough to clear the platform's review.
Schedule everything, keep spare versions for Cyber Monday, and swap out anything that isn't getting clicks.

faq.q: How early should I make my Black Friday ads?
faq.a: Several weeks ahead gives you time to try a few versions and leaves room for ad review. Because prices go on afterward, you can finish the visuals before your discounts are settled.

faq.q: Can you add a countdown timer to my video?
faq.a: No. Add the countdown in CapCut or with your ad platform's own tools, where you control the exact end time.

faq.q: Do I need a separate video for each platform?
faq.a: Usually a 9:16 version covers TikTok, Reels and Stories, and a 1:1 version covers the feeds. Each one is its own generation, with its credit cost shown up front.
